row.evidence: Whatfix's quote-only pricing (Standard, Premium, Enterprise; 'Get a Demo' / 'Talk to Sales') lists SSO on every plan but no SCIM, and Dashboard teammates are added, deactivated and deleted manually in Settings > Teammates.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public prices; Standard/Premium say 'Get a Demo' and Enterprise 'Talk to Sales'. SSO (SAML, for dashboard content creators and end users) is ticked for every web/desktop plan in the pricing page markup. No SCIM endpoint or provisioning connector found in the pricing page, the support sitemap (2,697 English URLs), llms.txt index, or the API reference. The public REST API (API token enabled by Whatfix support) manages DAP end-user attribute records for segmentation and exposes an audit-log endpoint, but has no Dashboard teammate (licensed author) endpoints. Entra gallery app is SAML only and needs users created first; no Okta OIN page (404). Category: digital adoption platform filed under Learning & Development.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: SSO tick read from pricing-page markup (text-check check).

scim.notes: No SCIM documented anywhere searched (see searched).

auth.notes: Per-user API token sent as x-whatfix-integration-key plus x-whatfix-user (email); token must be enabled by Whatfix support.

endpoints.purpose: Get all end users (paginated); DAP end-user attribute records, not Dashboard teammates
Update or add end users details
Delete one or more end users

limitations.text: API token must be enabled for the account by Whatfix support.

user_api.notes: available left null: the API manages end-user attribute data used for content segmentation, not the Dashboard teammates who hold Whatfix access; no teammate/user-admin endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/whatfix/ returned 404; Whatfix's SSO doc points to Okta's generic OIDC app guide.

entra.notes: SSO tutorial only; no provisioning tutorial (whatfix-provisioning-tutorial 404). Users must be created by Whatfix support first.

fallbacks.notes: Teammates are added in Settings > Teammates and can be marked inactive (content kept) or deleted. JIT false is from Microsoft's tutorial ('Users must be created and activated before you use single sign-on').
